purpose: Generate the Reference-only numerical self-disagreement dataset used later to freeze a RossFast-independent scientific admissibility rule.

initial_state_axis.coordinate: uniform effective saturation Se converted analytically to material-specific pressure head using the admitted Mualem-van Genuchten relation
initial_state_axis.rationale: Three predeclared hydraulic regimes spanning dry/intermediate/near-wet states while remaining strictly inside the admitted head interval for all six materials. For the limiting B12 material Se=0.65 corresponds to approximately -6950 cm, leaving margin to the -10000 cm state boundary.

boundary_axis.normalization: K0 is the admitted constitutive conductivity at the uniform initial state; top and bottom use the same K0 for the homogeneous initial column
boundary_axis.rationale: Symmetric interior sampling of the existing state-local D3R boundary envelope. Each perturbation is 0.015*K0 from the qualified reference forcing and therefore remains inside the 0.02*K0 envelope without sitting on its boundary.

temporal_axis.refined_rule: two sequential Reference solves of coarse_duration/2 to the same final physical time
temporal_axis.rationale: Predeclared 16-fold temporal span on the existing halving ladder without selecting levels from observed solver disagreement.

per_case_experiment.coarse: one legacy-reference-bound solver-seam trajectory over dt
per_case_experiment.refined: two sequential legacy-reference-bound solver-seam trajectories over dt/2 + dt/2

hard_case_validity_gates: all three Reference solves converge on route legacy-reference-bound
coarse and both half-step mass residuals are finite and <= 1e-12 cm in absolute value
all endpoint pressure-head and water-content values are finite
initial and endpoint states remain within the declared physical contract
coarse and refined endpoints share the same node count and final physical time
aggregation_allowed_after_execution: descriptive minima, maxima, medians and quantiles of Reference-only metrics
predeclared stratification by material, Se level, boundary regime and dt level
aggregation_not_yet_allowed: multiplicative safety factor chosen with knowledge of RossFast discrepancy
removal of numerically inconvenient cases after seeing results
failure_semantics: If any preregistered case violates a hard Reference validity gate, retain the case and report the matrix as BLOCKED_REFERENCE_DOMAIN_CASE rather than silently shrinking or replacing the domain.
next_permitted_action: Implement and execute exactly this 162-case Reference-only matrix with O0/O2 reproducibility; inspect only Reference outputs and hard validity status.
